		Dataset Summary
	

Platinum Benchmarks are benchmarks that are are carefully curated to minimize label errors and ambiguity, allowing us to measure reliability of models.
This repository contains a cache of the LLM inferences for the models we test in our paper… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/madrylab/platinum-bench-paper-cache.
reputation: Well-regarded, carefully curated benchmark suite from MadryLab designed to minimize label errors and used for robust LLM evaluation; gaining adoption for reliability studies.
